'''Franka Anić''' (born 5 February 1991 in [[Split, Croatia|Split]], [[Croatia]])<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.london2012.com/athlete/anic-franka-1119607/# |title=Franka Anic |access-date=10 August 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120809042125/http://www.london2012.com/athlete/anic-franka-1119607/# |archive-date=9 August 2012 |url-status=dead }}</ref> is a [[Slovenia]]n-[[Croatia]]n [[taekwondo]] athlete. Anić lives in [[Korčula]], [[Croatia]], but competes internationally for Slovenia.<ref>{{cite web|author=Iz Londona poroča Šime Dmitrović |url=http://www.zurnal24.si/prva-v-boj-franka-anic-clanek-164573 |title=Prva v boj Franka Anić – zurnal24 |publisher=Zurnal24.si }}</ref>

Anić qualified for the [[2012 Summer Olympics]] in the [[Taekwondo at the 2012 Summer Olympics – Women's 67&nbsp;kg|67 kg category]]. She reached the semifinals where she lost to [[Hwang Kyung-Seon]]. In the bronze medal match, she lost to [[Paige McPherson]], thus finishing in 5th place in the tournament.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.london2012.com/taekwondo/event/women-less-than-67kg/index.html|title=London 2012 57 – 67 kg women Results – Olympic taekwondo|access-date=26 August 2012|archive-date=21 July 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120721210942/http://www.london2012.com/taekwondo/event/women-less-than-67kg/index.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> She was Slovenia's flagbearer during the closing ceremonies.{{citation needed|date=March 2021}}
